neighbours.label: the verb or modal describing how a computer or piece of software performs, right before a performance word (it becomes unusable, may run slowly, can be sluggish); the output promotes 'slow/lag'
fire: With too many programs open, the old desktop tends to become unresponsive.
On older phones the app can be painfully sluggish when scrolling.
After installing the patch, my editor started running extremely slowly.
If the disk is nearly full, Windows may freeze for several seconds.
The spreadsheet gets laggy once it has more than a million rows.
Running the scan in the background, the laptop became almost unusable.
Large images can make the website load very slowly on mobile.
The virtual machine is noticeably slower when it has only one core.
quiet: With too many passengers aboard, the old ferry tends to sit low in the water.
On older bikes the chain can be painfully noisy when climbing.
After the long winter, my garden started growing extremely fast.
If the river is nearly full, the town may close the bridge for hours.
The bakery gets crowded once the morning commuters arrive.
Running the marathon in the heat, the runner became almost exhausted.
Large trucks can make the old road crack in the summer.
The kitten is noticeably calmer when it has only one toy.
